x03.title: Pravidlá tohto priestoru
x03.intro: CVH je pre susedov, ktorí si pomáhajú. Skôr ako niečo pridáte, prečítajte si toto.
rules: Zdieľajte miesta a pomoc, ktoré sú zadarmo alebo lacné a otvorené pre komunitu.
Píšte o mieste, nie o človeku. Nezdieľajte mená, čísla bytov ani telefónne čísla.
Buďte láskaví. Nič, čo uráža alebo cieli na skupinu ľudí.
Zdieľajte len to, o čom viete, že je pravda. Ak si nie ste istí, zvoľte „Nie som si istý“.

R26.lead: Vyberte všetky, ktoré sa vás týkajú. Podľa toho dostanete upozornenia a rady. Nikdy sa nepýtame prečo.

R27.lead: Odpovedzte len na otázky, na ktorých vám záleží. Všetko ostatné zostane otvorené.

R28.title: Čo znamená „overené“
R28.body: Overené znamená, že niekto v Hube alebo v partnerskej organizácii, s ktorou Hub spolupracuje, toto upozornenie pred odoslaním overil u ľudí priamo na mieste.
R28.notYet: Zatiaľ neoverené znamená, že upozornenie prišlo od ambasádora budovy, ktorý sa to často dozvie ako prvý. Hub ho skontroluje, hneď ako bude môcť.
R28.official: Oficiálne upozornenia prichádzajú od {source} a posielajú sa ďalej bez zmeny slov.
R28.notFalse: Zatiaľ neoverené neznamená, že je to nesprávne.
R28.notYetAct: Môžete podľa neho konať už teraz. Keď ho Hub skontroluje, bude na ňom namiesto toho „Overil Hub“.
R28.correctedLine: Opravené {t}. Upozornenie ukazuje, čo sa zmenilo, a predchádzajúce znenie sa dá stále prečítať.
R28.officialAdds: Hub nikdy nemení slová oficiálneho upozornenia. Môže však vo vlastnom komunitnom upozornení doplniť, čo sa deje vo vašej budove.
R28.legendVerified: Niekto v Hube alebo u partnera to skontroloval pred odoslaním.
R28.legendUnverified: Zverejnil to ambasádor budovy. Hub to zatiaľ neskontroloval.
R28.legendOfficial: Od štátneho zdroja, odovzdané ďalej slovo za slovom.

R29.title: Zdieľať toto upozornenie
R29.everyone: Túto verziu dostanú všetci. Nič, čo je prispôsobené vám, sa nezdieľa.

R29.lead: Vaši susedia dostanú upozornenie tak, ako ho napísal Hub, aj s tým, odkiaľ pochádza, a s odkazom na najnovšiu verziu.

R33.title: Požiadať o kontrolu

people.title: [EN] Add a person
people.lead: [EN] Each person gets their own account. Nothing is sent to them: give them their username and starting password yourself.

people.emailHint: [EN] Kept as a contact detail. The Hub does not send email.
people.createdLine: [EN] Give them these in person. The starting password works once, within 24 hours. They choose their own password when they first sign in.

authenticator.title: [EN] Set up your authenticator
authenticator.lead: [EN] Admins and Coordinators confirm each sign-in with a code from an authenticator app on their phone.

authenticator.keyHint: [EN] This key is shown only now. If you leave this page, start again to get a new one.

reissue.title: [EN] Re-issue a starting password
reissue.lead: [EN] For someone whose starting password expired before they used it, or who signed in once without choosing their own password.
reissue.doneLine: [EN] Give it to them in person. It works once, within 24 hours.

errors.notReissuable: [EN] This person already chose their own password, or their account is suspended or removed.

admins.shortfallLine: [EN] Restore a second usable Admin: reset the password or authenticator of an Admin who cannot sign in, or give another person the Admin role. Until then, Admins cannot be suspended, removed or given another role.

resetPassword.title: [EN] Reset a password
resetPassword.lead: [EN] For someone who forgot their password. They get a new starting password and are signed out on every device.
resetPassword.doneLine: [EN] Give it to them in person. It works once, within 24 hours. They were signed out on every device.

errors.notResettable: [EN] This account is suspended or removed, so its password cannot be reset.

errors.passwordsNotConfigured: [EN] Staff passwords are not configured on this site (STAFF_PASSWORD_PEPPER), so nothing was reset. Ask IT to set it.

smsTest.title: [EN] Test text
smsTest.lead: [EN] Send one test text from production to an approved phone, to learn whether the Twilio account and the toll-free number work. Nothing is retried automatically.
smsTest.previewOnly: [EN] Texts are only sent from production
smsTest.notConfigured: [EN] Texts can go out from here, but the Twilio account, the toll-free number or the approved phones are not set, or one is not valid. Ask IT to check TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER and SMS_TEST_ALLOWLIST in production.
smsTest.numberHint: [EN] Only the approved phones are listed. The text is "CVH test from production".

sent.heading: [EN] Twilio accepted the test text
sent.line: [EN] Delivery is not tracked in this check: look at the phone.

failed.heading: [EN] Twilio did not send the test text
failed.bare: [EN] Twilio answered HTTP {http} without an error message.
failed.line: [EN] Nothing was retried. Fix the cause, then press the button again.

noAnswer.heading: [EN] Twilio did not answer
noAnswer.line: [EN] The text may or may not have been sent. Nothing was retried, and no second text can go to this phone for 5 minutes.

unknown.heading: [EN] Outcome unknown
unknown.lead: [EN] These attempts were started, but Twilio’s answer was never recorded, so the text may or may not have been sent. Look at the phone. No second text can go to the same phone for 5 minutes after an attempt.

errors.forbidden: [EN] Only an Admin can send a test text.
errors.invalid: [EN] That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.

errors.unavailable: [EN] The test text could not be sent right now. Nothing was sent.
